title: The world's first spinal cord transplant has been performed in Russia | New Scientist
description: A surgeon has told New Scientist they have performed a transplant on someone with a complete spinal cord injury using a piece of spinal cord from a brain-dead donor, but researchers have raised concerns
author: Helen Thomson

title: UN says 1.5°C is over and world is on track for 2.8°C of global warming | New Scientist
description: The best-case scenario now is that the planet will only temporarily breach 1.5°C of warming, but current climate pledges fall way short of that hope
author: Madeleine Cuff

title: 1 in 4 cases of depression may be caused by off-kilter body clocks | New Scientist
description: Many cases of depression may be related to disrupted body clocks, with this understanding offering new ways to treat it
author: Alice Klein

title: Parasite-infected mosquitoes released in Europe for first time | New Scientist
description: Male mosquitoes infected with a parasite have been released in Barcelona to reduce the number of insects that can transmit infections such as dengue
author: Michael Le Page

title: 1000 human mathematicians pledge to shun AI in their research | New Scientist
description: There is a growing backlash against the way AI companies have gone about tackling mathematical problems – and now some mathematicians are opting to avoid AI altogether
author: Matthew Sparkes

title: It's about to get a lot harder to keep countries honest about climate change | New Scientist
description: A row over when to publish crucial climate change assessments risks letting countries off the hook on emissions cuts
author: Madeleine Cuff
